evidence: The substrates were cleaned with acetone and isopropanol, dried in an UHP nitrogen flow, and kept in the ALD chamber for ~30 min prior to deposition. All the used Si 〈100〉 plates had a natural layer of silicon oxide with a thickness of ~20 Å.
